sentences.en: We've got eyedrops and an oral antibiotic to give them.
sentences.zh: 我们有眼药水和口服抗生素可以给他们用。

sentences.en: My doctor told me to put the eyedrops in my eyes three times a day.
sentences.zh: 医生告诉我一天要滴三次眼药水到眼睛里。

sentences.en: Mary uses eyedrops for her dry eyes.
sentences.zh: 玛丽用眼药水来缓解干眼症状。

senses.zh: 眼药水；滴眼剂；眼泪（eyedrop的复数）
